title: Warm Dutch Apple Fritters
description: A citrusy and chewy Dutch dish featuring caramelized sugar sauce, perfect as a quick-fix dessert or snack. This satvik-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together sugar, milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Fold in the apple cider, lemon zest, and diced apples.
Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 375 degrees.
Using a cookie scoop, drop the batter into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a small saucepan, caramelize 1/2 cup of sugar over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Drizzle the caramelized sugar sauce over the warm fritters and serve immediately.
